description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/ordering-online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccess" name="Successful login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailure" name="Failed login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompletedOrder" name="Completed order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment authorization request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AddressDetails" name="Address details"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginCredentials" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailure" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompletedOrder" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_CompletedOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_RequestPaymentAuthorization" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationToShop" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Event_ShopPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationToCustomer" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AddressDetails" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAddressDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForLogin" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Shopping stops"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckProducts" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Are all products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit completed order" messageRef="Message_CompletedOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" name="Complete payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentData" name="Provide payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" name="Bank confirms payment">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" name="Is the billing address different?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" name="Continue with address details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideAddressDetails" name="Provide address details" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrder" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_08" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_09" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckProducts" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" name="Not all selected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" name="All selected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentData" targetRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" name="Same address" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddress = billingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" name="Different address" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" targetRef="Task_ProvideAddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAddressDetails" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerOrder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login requested">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginResult" name="Are credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_LoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_LoginFailure" name="Send failed login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailureShop" name="Login unsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive completed order" messageRef="Message_CompletedOrder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrderInitial" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShopWorkSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestPaymentAuthorization" name="Request payment authorization" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ShopPaymentConfirmation" name="Receive bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ShopPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" name="Receive address details" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShopWorkJoin" name="Payment and shipment ready"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrderFinal" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_01" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_03" name="Credentials valid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_04" name="Credentials invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_LoginFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_05" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_06" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailureShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderInitial"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_08" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderInitial" targetRef="Gateway_ShopWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_10" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_RequestPaymentAuthorization"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestPaymentAuthorization" targetRef="Event_ShopPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_13" sourceRef="Event_ShopPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_ShopWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_16" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" targetRef="Gateway_ShopWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_18" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderFinal" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
